philippines.title: 3 marijuana plantations destroyed in Benguet
philippines.description:
BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — Police discovered three marijuana plantations in the towns of Kapangan and Kibungan in Benguet, and seized plants and seedlings with an estimated street value of P270,000 during eradication operations on Friday, Oct. 30. In a statement, the Police Regional Office-Cordillera (PRO-CAR) said the plantations were found in Barangay Sagubo in Kapangan and Barangay Poblacion in Kibungan during joint police and anti-drug operations. Authorities recovered 1,000 marijuana seedlings worth P40,000 from a plantation in Kapangan and 1,150 fully grown marijuana plants valued at P230,000 from two plantations in Kibungan, based on the standard drug price.
